clips.title: The story
paras: Young night elves begin their training in Shadowglen, beneath the boughs of Teldrassil. The vale gathers around Aldrassil, where elders, priestesses, and mentors guide them before they travel farther into the world.

Shadowglen lies beneath the northeastern boughs of Teldrassil, ringed by high ridges that shelter it from the rest of the world. Eternal dusk falls over the vale, where Aldrassil rises as a massive barrow-tree. Its hollowed trunk houses elders, priestesses, and mentors who guide young night elves beginning their training. A narrow mountain pass leads south toward Starbreeze Village and Dolanaar. This single route out leaves the sanctuary sheltered and peaceful.

Danger reaches even this sheltered vale. Shadowthread Cave lies in the extreme northwest, where venomous spiders threaten the glade. Young defenders drive back the encroaching vermin and untamed wildlife before venturing farther among Teldrassil's boughs.
